note: The line's first byte is `[`, so § 5.0.1 diagnoses an unterminated inline-array attempt (§ 5.2 rule 9) before the line is ever considered as a pair candidate -- it never reaches key validation, even though `[bad]` would also be an invalid key on its own. Moved here from invalid_key/bracket_in_key: a bracket elsewhere in the key (e.g. `a{b: 1`) is unaffected and still yields InvalidKey.
